description.value:
A capacity attachment: it adds rounds to the weapon's base capacity, by weapon type: Pistol (all) +6, SMG (all) +10, Crossbow +5, Shotgun +4, Assault Rifle +10, Machine Gun +20, Sniper Rifle +4, Grenade Launcher +2, Rocket Launcher +1.

One capacity attachment per weapon. Crossbows can take one too; a loaded crossbow magazine holds one arrow type (you can still hand-load another with a free hand).

Item Compendium (2070) • Attachments & Mods
